description: February 27 birthday meaning: Pisces decan 1, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 27 birthday falls in Pisces, in the first decan, with Neptune as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Pisces is mutable and water.

sections.heading: The February 27 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Compassion is doubled on February 27. The 27 reduces to 9, numerology's humanitarian, and the Sun sits close to eight degrees of Pisces, a mutable water sign already associated with selflessness. Neptune sub-rules the decan, deepening the idealism. The traditional portrait is a gentle helper whose kindness reaches strangers as easily as friends.

Astronomically, February 27 puts the Sun near 8° Pisces in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Neptune. Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces, also governs the sign's first decan, from about February 19 to February 28. This is often seen as the most dreamy and boundless part of the zodiac's final sign. Natives tend to be imaginative, compassionate and highly sensitive to music, mood and meaning. They may move through the world like a sponge, absorbing atmosphere and other people's feelings. Doubled Neptune can blur practical edges and make escape tempting when life feels harsh. Creative work, spiritual practice and caring roles often give this decan a way to channel what it senses.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for February 27
paragraphs: Born on the 27th, you carry the compound 2 + 7 = 9. The 2 adds sensitivity, the 7 adds depth and reflection, and the 9 that results is compassionate and wide-ranging. People born on this day are often described as wise beyond their years, drawn to teaching, counselling or creative work that helps others make sense of things. Their emotional insight can be striking. Taken as a secondary number, the 27 is traditionally associated with leadership through understanding rather than force. Accepting differing views with patience tends to strengthen their influence over time.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a February 27 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 22 and 33. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous February 27 birthdays
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 27 is the 58th day of the year. Counting forward, the next sign change, into Aries, is usually complete within 23 days, by March 21.

By February 27 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a February 27 birthday are John Steinbeck (1902), Elizabeth Taylor (1932) and Joanne Woodward (1930).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 27?
faq.answer: February 27 is Pisces in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Pisces, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 27?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 27 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 2 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 27th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 27?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by February 27, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 27?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on February 27 include John Steinbeck (1902), Elizabeth Taylor (1932) and Joanne Woodward (1930). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
